summary:
Implemented the feature in the repository, without committing or running tests. Changes: (1) rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__, an iterative stack-based walk that measures each label with the unreduced max_width, adds 4 cells per level, and descends only into expanded nodes with children; imports Measurement from .measure. (2) rich/align.py: added Align.__repr__ returning "Align(<repr renderable>, <repr align>)", and a new VerticalCenter(JupyterMixin) class placed after Align and before the main guard, which renders lines with pad=False and emits newline-only padding based on console.size.height, plus a measurement method delegating to Measurement.get. (3) CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 heading marked Unreleased, with an Added section listing the two new entries; the existing markdown-over-STDIN bullet is kept (now under Added). (4) tests/test_align.py: VerticalCenter import, repr test, VerticalCenter rendering test (expects "

foo


" at height 6), and measurement test (3, 3). (5) tests/test_tree.py: Measurement import between console and tree imports, and a measure test expecting Measurement(11, 19). Existing tests were left unchanged. Skipped the two secondary reference-only behaviors (Align width constraint and print justify) since no test requires them. Tests were not run, so all verification is by reading the code.
